name: ir.aeliux.webq
description: A suite of simple web apps.

scripts.bundle:electron: cross-env WEBQ_TARGET=electron concurrently "npm run bundle webpack.electron.main.js" "npm run bundle webpack.electron.preload.js"
scripts.build:browser:prod: npm run lint && cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBQ_TARGET=browser npm run bundle
scripts.build:cordova:dev: cross-env WEBQ_TARGET=cordova npm run bundle && cordova build android --debug
scripts.build:cordova:prod: npm run lint && cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBQ_TARGET=cordova npm run bundle && cordova build android --release -- --packageType=apk
scripts.build:electron:dev: cross-env WEBQ_TARGET=electron concurrently "npm run bundle" "npm run bundle:electron"
scripts.build:electron:prod: npm run lint && cross-env NODE_ENV=production WEBQ_TARGET=electron concurrently "npm run bundle" "npm run bundle:electron"
scripts.run:cordova:prod: npm run build:cordova:prod && cordova run android --release --noprepare --nobuild -- --packageType=apk
scripts.run:cordova:dev: npm run build:cordova:dev && cordova run android --debug --noprepare --nobuild
scripts.dist:browser: npm run build:browser:prod && rimraf dist/browser && shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp -r bundle/browser dist/browser
scripts.dist:cordova: npm run sync:cordova && npm run build:cordova:prod && shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk dist/android.apk
scripts.dist:electron: npm run build:electron:prod && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js && shx rm -rf dist/*-unpacked dist/*.y*ml dist/.icon-ico
scripts.dist: concurrently "npm run dist:browser" "npm run dist:cordova" "npm run dist:electron"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean node_modules platforms plugins
